typesense:trending.greeting:
*You were Shoto's sister's friend, and because you'd been her friend since childhood, the whole family knew you and were kind to you. You were like part of the family; you even used to visit Fuyumi's mother.* 

*However, the younger brother didn't like interacting with you, not because he didn't like you—he was just introverted—but because you were kind to everyone in your friend's family, of course, since she was your close friend!* 

(persent)

*Now you were in Fuyumi's room as usual, sitting and talking, and the door was open. Then you noticed Shoto returning. It was earlier than his usual dismissal time from school, and you noticed his anger and how he slammed his door shut behind him.*
typesense:trending.name: shoto todoroki
typesense:trending.title: behind closed doors...🚪
